description: Benchmark the membrane-docking score of the CrtY model against monotopic membrane enzymes and soluble FAD flavoprotein controls
code:
import os, json, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd(); exec(open(os.path.join(OUT,'crty_lib.py')).read(), globals())
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})

CTRL=[
 ('1SQC','A','squalene-hopene cyclase (A. acidocaldarius)','monotopic, lipophilic substrate'),
 ('1PRH','A','prostaglandin H synthase-1 (ovine COX-1)','monotopic, lipophilic substrate'),
 ('1MT5','A','fatty acid amide hydrolase (rat FAAH)','monotopic, lipophilic substrate'),
 ('1PBE','A','p-hydroxybenzoate hydroxylase (PHBH)','soluble FAD Rossmann'),
 ('3GRS','A','human glutathione reductase','soluble FAD Rossmann'),
 ('1GOS','A','human monoamine oxidase B','FAD Rossmann, membrane-bound (C-term TM helix)'),
 ('1FOH','A','phenol 2-monooxygenase','soluble FAD Rossmann'),
]
rows=[]
for pdbid,ch,name,klass in CTRL:
    try:
        txt=S.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/%s.pdb'%pdbid,timeout=120).text
        at=parse_pdb(txt,chain=ch)
        if len(at)<500: print(pdbid,"parse failed",len(at)); continue
        a_=sasa(at); mf=membrane_fit(at,a_,ndir=300,step=1.0)
        n=mf['normal']; d=mf['d']
        X=np.array([[q['x'],q['y'],q['z']] for q in at]); dep=d-(X@n)
        ins=(dep>0)&(a_>1.0); bur=float(a_[ins].sum())
        rows.append(dict(pdb=pdbid,name=name,klass=klass,natoms=len(at),total_asa=float(a_.sum()),
                         dG=mf['dG'],z=mf['z'],buried_asa=bur,frac_buried=bur/a_.sum(),
                         dG_per_1000A2=1000*mf['dG']/a_.sum()))
        print("%-5s %-45s dG=%8.1f  z=%6.2f  buriedASA=%6.0f (%.1f%%)"%(pdbid,name,mf['dG'],mf['z'],bur,100*bur/a_.sum()))
    except Exception as e:
        print(pdbid,"FAILED",repr(e))

# CrtY same settings for a fair comparison
txt=open(os.path.join(OUT,'AF-P21687-F1-model_v6.pdb')).read()
at=parse_pdb(txt); a_=sasa(at); mf=membrane_fit(at,a_,ndir=300,step=1.0)
n=mf['normal']; d=mf['d']; X=np.array([[q['x'],q['y'],q['z']] for q in at]); dep=d-(X@n)
ins=(dep>0)&(a_>1.0); bur=float(a_[ins].sum())
rows.append(dict(pdb='AF-P21687',name='CrtY lycopene beta-cyclase (P. ananatis)',klass='query (AlphaFold model)',
                 natoms=len(at),total_asa=float(a_.sum()),dG=mf['dG'],z=mf['z'],buried_asa=bur,
                 frac_buried=bur/a_.sum(),dG_per_1000A2=1000*mf['dG']/a_.sum()))
print("%-5s %-45s dG=%8.1f  z=%6.2f  buriedASA=%6.0f (%.1f%%)"%('CrtY','AlphaFold P21687',mf['dG'],mf['z'],bur,100*bur/a_.sum()))

# CrtY with C-terminal 350-382 removed: does the signal survive?
at2=[q for q in at if q['resi']<350]
a2=sasa(at2); mf2=membrane_fit(at2,a2,ndir=300,step=1.0)
X2=np.array([[q['x'],q['y'],q['z']] for q in at2]); dep2=mf2['d']-(X2@mf2['normal'])
ins2=(dep2>0)&(a2>1.0); bur2=float(a2[ins2].sum())
rows.append(dict(pdb='AF-P21687_1-349',name='CrtY with C-terminal 350-382 deleted',klass='query (deletion control)',
                 natoms=len(at2),total_asa=float(a2.sum()),dG=mf2['dG'],z=mf2['z'],buried_asa=bur2,
                 frac_buried=bur2/a2.sum(),dG_per_1000A2=1000*mf2['dG']/a2.sum()))
print("%-5s %-45s dG=%8.1f  z=%6.2f  buriedASA=%6.0f (%.1f%%)"%('CrtYd','CrtY 1-349 (C-term deleted)',mf2['dG'],mf2['z'],bur2,100*bur2/a2.sum()))
seg2=sorted({at2[i]['resi'] for i in np.where(ins2)[0]})
print("  residual interface residues:",seg2)

T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
T.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,'membrane_docking_benchmark.csv'),index=False)
pd.set_option('display.width',260)
print("\n"+T[['pdb','klass','total_asa','dG','z','buried_asa','frac_buried','dG_per_1000A2']].to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda v:'%.2f'%v))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
cmap={'monotopic, lipophilic substrate':'#c0392b','soluble FAD Rossmann':'#2980b9',
      'FAD Rossmann, membrane-bound (C-term TM helix)':'#8e44ad','query (AlphaFold model)':'#27ae60',
      'query (deletion control)':'#7f8c8d'}
lbl=T['pdb']
for ax,(col,ttl) in zip(axes,[('dG_per_1000A2','Transfer energy per 1000 A2 of surface'),('frac_buried','Fraction of surface below the fitted membrane plane')]):
    cols=[cmap[k] for k in T['klass']]
    ax.barh(range(len(T)), T[col], color=cols)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(T))); ax.set_yticklabels(lbl)
    ax.set_xlabel(col); ax.set_title(ttl, fontsize=10); ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.grid(axis='x',alpha=.3)
handles=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=v) for v in cmap.values()]
axes[1].legend(handles, cmap.keys(), fontsize=7, loc='lower right')
plt.suptitle('Monotopic membrane-docking score: CrtY model against structurally characterised controls',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
